items.title: Using simple pendulum to measure g

source_refs.note: Using simple pendulum to measure g: a main subheading of 14.3 Practical S.H.M Systems, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 25-25.

blocks.text: The simple pendulum can be used to determine the gravitational acceleration at a particular location. We measure the length 'ℓ' of the pendulum and then set the pendulum into motion.
